description.text: Battle Master Deck Chien-Pao ex, released on 17 May 2024 with Terastal Charizard ex's: a ready-built 60-card deck of the kind that did well in official tournaments, around Chien-Pao ex in a new illustration. From the Active Spot it fetches up to two basic Water Energy from the deck each turn, and its attack does 60 damage for each Water Energy discarded from your Pokémon. Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR, Baxcalibur and Radiant Greninja back it up. Each box held the deck, 64 deck sleeves, damage counters and markers, a playmat, a coin, a VSTAR marker, a how-to-play guide and the player's guide Road to Battle Master.
